moments.action: Lynn stands on a station platform scowling at her phone while a man in a suit strides past the camera; by the last shot she has spun round, startled, staring after him.
One held take in the print shop: Pat hurries across to Grace, hunched over a laptop in her blue uniform, and by the end of the shot he is crouched beside her holding his phone to the screen.
A whip-pan snaps back to the station. Lynn's hands work a cracked phone, the text box filling to 'C A', and she ends walking the platform with her frown deepening over the screen.
A wall clock reads 07:22; outside the exam centre students shout and clutch their heads, then a ringed hand twists a motorbike throttle and the bike blurs away out of frame.
A figure in a dark shirt climbs onto a bench and shoves a ceiling panel aside; the reverse angle from below shows only his legs as he hauls himself up into the roof.
The screen now reads 'C A B B'. Lynn grimaces over it and turns away into the dark, and by the last shot she has stopped dead on the empty platform, chin up, looking down the line.
Lynn reads the station: a 'Platform 12 / No Exit' sign, a blurred pan over the Redfern tiling, then she stands under the Sydenham board with her hair lifting before swinging away.
Lynn feeds a coin into a vending machine and jabs the keypad; the coil turns on a chocolate-chip cookie, and the moment ends on her face, eyes dropping, worn out.
Commuter legs hurry past as Lynn keeps thumbing answer strings into the cracked phone; a tear runs down her cheek, and by the last shot the chat has filled with sent letter codes.
In the print shop Pat grins at his phone, Grace builds an A-B-C-D barcode on a laptop, and Pat ends the run walking off between the presses with a roll of printed paper.
A hand lifts a drink and the cookie out of the vending tray; Lynn's head drops, a suited commuter passes, the print shop stirs, and she ends tearing the wrapper open and eating ravenously.
Held wide outside the exam centre: students stream out of the gates and thread through a line of orange-vested motorbike taxis waiting to ride them away.
